phases.goal: Pick or stabilize the tea-box so it can be scanned.
phases.name: acquire_tea_box
phases.verify: Tea-box is visible and controlled or stably presented.

phases.goal: Grip the handheld barcode scanner as the scanning tool.
phases.name: grasp_scanner
phases.verify: Scanner moves with the gripper and its scanning face is visible.

phases.goal: Use the scanner on the tea-box.
phases.name: scan_tea_box
phases.verify: Scanner is aimed at or swept over the tea-box at close range.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Tea-box remains visible as the scanned object.
Scanner is the tool and must not be the sole active object for all phases.
Scanner face is brought to a plausible scan relation with the tea-box.

roles.target_relation: scanner aimed at or swept across the tea-box code/object

task_language: Pick the smooth black tea-box, grab the lightweight handheld barcode scanner, and use the scanner to scan the object.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid moving only the scanner without presenting the object; verify the scanner face is aimed at or swept across the visible tea-box.
